note: St. Charles County Parks campground at Riverside Landing on the Mississippi, with a free boat ramp, playground and overlook: concrete electric pads, 13 at 54 ft and 5 at 34 ft. --Claude
summary: County pages confirm $25/night electric sites, 18 concrete pads (13 x 54 ft, 5 x 34 ft), dump station, non-potable water, 6 people a site, online (WebTrac) or phone booking, a standing two-night minimum (marked) and a 14-day limit. Riverview confirmed: pads ~35-70 m from the river across the loop drive.
flags: Two-night minimum: STANDING, not time-of-year - both county pages state 'two-night minimum' with no season or waiver (the camping page applies the same to cabins and group sites). Already marked in booking.min_stay (applies always); kept.

Waterfront (stored riverview): confirmed. On imagery the 18 RV pads form a herringbone in the inner loop at ~38.8611,-90.5346; the northern pads are ~35 m and the southern ~70 m from the river's edge, with the loop's outer drive and a grassy bank with scattered trees between - an open sightline to the ~270 m-wide river, but a road between, so not riverfront. No levee between the pads and the river (the park sits riverward of the railroad on the bank). The stored waterfront_evidence is only a commit reference; suggested evidence: 'Esri 0.5 m/px: pads 35-70 m from the Mississippi across the loop drive and open grass bank; no levee on the river side'.
Pin: stored 38.8610,-90.5330 sits on the roundabout ~140 m east of the pads; the pad centroid is ~38.8611,-90.5346 (under the 250 m line, no correction required).

Park water: 'All water at this park is non-potable' (read 2026-11-08) - still current; note's mention removed as facilities.potable_water false shows it. Season: the county says camping is reservable 'throughout the year' in general but states no Riverside Landing season - season left absent. Hookup amperage (stored 50 from the old note's '20/30/50A') is not stated on the county pages; left alone.
